source_1.title: New forecast tools to enhance the value of VRE on the electricity markets, TradeRES Deliverable D4.9 edition 2
source_1.direct_new_detail: Equations 16-18 prescribe centred MSLP spatial derivatives, time derivative of gradient norm, and 2nd/98th spatial-percentile ramp events.

source_2.title: Couto & Estanqueiro (2022), Enhancing wind power forecast accuracy using WRF NWP-based features and ANN
source_2.direct_new_detail: Equation 1 fixes first-order centred finite differences for MSLPGrad on projected x/y; the 00 UTC WRF run covers 48 h and evaluates the last 24 h; full text exposes feature-selection and spatial-PCA boundaries.

objective: Audit whether the newly retrieved exact primary/full-text formulas cure every N27 admission gate. At most one exact no-fit prerequisite may be selected; otherwise close NONE and restore the exhausted halt.
fixed_questions: Does the full text fix source, field, projection, grid domain, boundary handling, output reduction, and local supplied mapping without analyst choice?
Does it isolate a 12-36 h wind-power effect for that same treatment rather than a selected multifeature system or unevaluated alert?
Is its information/operation absent from current fixed representation rather than merely a compression of already represented local grids?
Can the treatment be computed strictly same-issuance under the unchanged runtime with no external inference/data at deployment?
admission_gates: literal supplied field and unit availability in both or one source
strict same-issuance computation and D-1 14:00 symmetry
one deterministic grid/coordinate/gradient/projection formula with no tuned scale, level, subset, or aggregation
operation-level nonduplication against current source and closed lanes
plausible target-scale effect evidence rather than generic meteorological relevance
commercial/open-source compatibility if external code is needed; external code is not preferred
selection_rule: Select at most one no-fit prerequisite only if every N27 admission gate is now directly supported by one internally consistent treatment. Cross-paper/source bridging, unisolated suite gains, future-work validation, or local grid/domain substitution forces NONE.
forbidden: new external data/object/API bodies or attachments
